raw_response:
This maize is how my family eats, so I must put fertilizer if I can get the coupon — without it, the yield on this rented plot is too little. I managed to get the FISP package this year, so I will use the NPK and urea on it, and try to use the hybrid seed that came with the coupon. I cannot afford pesticide, and there is no way to irrigate here — we wait for the rains like everyone else. I will do most of the hoeing and weeding myself with my wife, but at weeding time I may call a few people for ganyu to help so the weeds don't beat us.
